title: Australian BYD ATTO 1 current-trim evidence
scope: Current official Australian ATTO 1 BEV order trims plus exact new-stock evidence; no code or Codex task work
currentVerifiedTrimCoverage: Complete for the two named current official AU trims. Exact MY applicability and Essential current new-stock availability remain unresolved.

modelYearEvidence.basis: The currently linked brochure has explicit MY25 Title metadata. Current product page and order form do not state MY. Live inventory calendar labels 2025 Model and 2026 Model are retained separately and do not establish MY25/MY26. Matching trim names/specifications are not treated as proof of exact MY applicability.

battery.capacityBasis: Manufacturer advertised battery capacity; gross versus usable not stated
battery.chemistryLocator: p172 High-Voltage Battery: EQEAX and EQEBX each lithium iron phosphate; p171 motor powers match Essential/Premium
battery.qualification: Do not import smaller non-Australian ATTO 1/Seagull battery capacities.

range.locator: Technical Specifications modal, Essential tab > Driveline > Combined range WLTP
range.qualification: Laboratory claim, not real-world range. Brochure table also labels WLTP; its generic notice separately cites ADR 81/02, so retain the explicit current-product combined-WLTP label rather than infer another test cycle.

seats.locator: PDF p2 Dimensions > Seating capacity, shared value across both exact trims
seats.corroboratingLocator: p171 Number of occupants: 4 for EQEAX and EQEBX
seats.claimScope: Both named Australian brochure trims; exact current-product seating supported by matching Australian handbook

cargo.locator: Product Clever storage solutions; brochure p2 Boot/Load Space Min/Max
cargo.measurementBasis: Manufacturer boot capacity with rear seats in use; expands when rear seats folded
cargo.qualification: VDA/SAE method, underfloor inclusion, parcel-shelf versus roof loading height and front trunk capacity not verified. Do not standardize or rank cross-brand cargo volumes as equivalent.

towing.qualification: Handbook instructs not to use vehicle to tow other vehicles and says trailer-towing damage/malfunction is outside warranty. No numeric Australian braked/unbraked rating verified. Keep null, not 0 kg.

charging.locator: Brochure p2 New Energy: AC Charging Port Type 2 / DC Charging Port CCS2; showcase ATTO 1 Charging Information
charging.ratingScope: Manufacturer vehicle charging acceptance/port rating, not external station output

ACChargeTime.qualification: Published time, charger/test conditions not expressly specified in the time row. Do not promise this on a household outlet or optional 7 kW home charger.

DCChargeTime.qualification: Manufacturer published time for both variants; not an observed real-world test or guaranteed flat-rate charging curve.

otherPublishedDCClaim.locator: p2 New Energy row explicitly printed DC Charging Time (30%-100%)
otherPublishedDCClaim.qualification: Unexplained alternate window; do not silently relabel it as 30-80%. It is shorter than the brochure 10-80% time; no reconciliation verified.

charging.qualification: The optional 7 kW BYD home charger in configurator is an accessory/station rating and does not replace the 11 kW vehicle AC rating.

dimensions.widthQualification: Handbook p170 labels width excluding side mirrors

price.configuratorBasePriceBasis: Exact variant-level price field includes GST (price/11 GST field); options and on-road amounts calculated separately. No explicit MLP/MSRP label or official manufacturer price list found. Do not silently promote it to formal MLP.
price.optionsBasis: Apricity White, standard wheels and Black + Grey interior; optional paint is A$500 base before any applicable on-road effect
price.registrationScope: Promo is current Australian retail driveaway campaign. Configurator defaults to NSW private registration but no personalized driveaway calculation performed. Premium exact unit prices are under availability.
doNotUse: 6% lease discount as a universal cash-purchase discount

orderEvidence.basis: Exact variants appear in manufacturer-linked retailer configuration; form presents a fully refundable A$1,000 order fee and explicitly says submission is an order request subject to vehicle allocation. No transaction attempted.
